_note: FL31 patch fragment: spine flags that already own a record (FL22, FL27, FL29, FL30). Apply after those fragments: each entry carries expectOld.

meanings.notes: One setter (UseItem_LanceLetter, display-only handler), one reader. Name from the item; the letter says 'I'm going to the Great Wall of China'. Relation: overworld_exit tests $94 first, then $8E (overworld_exit.asm:345 note), so $94 wins when both are set.

Setter: the neo queen watcher (code_0BA65F, spawned by btF6_neo_queen, scene $F6): after enemiesRemaining = 0 and the teleport byte $01 clear it runs Transform_ShadowToWill, SetFlagWord #$0179 and queues scene $E3 at (01F8,03A0). Agrees with the FL11 proposal. The name has the crystal gate letter e like gates a-d ($0175-$0178). Decision: the FL29 meaning (Neo Queen watcher, scene $F6) stands; the earlier proposal 'Mummy Queen rematch' is contradicted. The only setter (pyDD_mummy_queen.asm:109 {763546}) lies in code_0BA65F, spawned by btF6_neo_queen (pyDD_mummy_queen.asm:52 {763426}), which tables/scene_actors.asm:4695 places in the Babel boss lair; the Mummy Queen actor of the same file (placed at tables/scene_actors.asm:4450) does not reach it. The file sits in the pyramid folder only because of its position in the bank, which is why the inventory counts a second group for this flag.
